description: Surface Optimization of the (111) Surface of CeO2 (Cubic, Fm-3m) and Surface Oxygen Vacancy Formation Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Compute the formation energy of a surface oxygen vacancy on the CeO2(111) surface (fluorite structure, Fm-3m). Optimize both the clean slab and the slab with one surface O removed, then compute E_vf = E(defective) - E(clean) + 1/2 * E(O2). Report E_vf in eV.
